All ten occurrences inspect installed modeling classes/functions for forward, attention, causal-mask, checkpointing, router-logit and callable rewrites. Names originate in that module's source or namespace; the compiler validates the Transformers model type before constructing its module path.

The compiler's source-generation helper recovers base classes from its caller-selected, already imported library module. This API deliberately accepts Python source; it is a trusted code-generation boundary, not a model-data parser.
Looks up a torch.nn class in the imported torch namespace; module is selected from this file's fixed _patch_functions list of normalization and convolution class names.

Rebinds entries in registries found inside the installed modeling module to compiled replacements. Registry names/keys come from that trusted Python module, and replacement names come from compiler-discovered classes; arbitrary external mappings are not the input contract.

Binds the same dtype-safe callable through combined_module.nn; the only interpolated class name is selected from the fixed _patch_functions list.

Installs the fixed no_update_causal_mask callable on a compiler-selected installed model class after checking its method and model category; target identifiers originate in the modeling module.

The three reviewed occurrences install inspected library-source rewrites: Torch end_capture, Torch AutogradEngineVariable.call_method, and Transformers bitsandbytes conversion. Each transformation adds fixed compatibility/parent-tracking code rather than interpolating model payloads.

Applies this file's fixed Torch compiler configuration assignments; substitutions are Boolean optimization/debug flags or one of two literal optimization levels, not externally supplied Python expressions.

Imports Linear names obtained from dir() of an already imported installed PEFT module; both the module and exported names belong to that trusted package.

Intentional function-source API: validate_single_function_source checks a single function AST before compilation and postpones annotations. The generated-function wrapper defaults to restricted builtins; explicit full mode remains trusted developer-code execution, not an untrusted-code sandbox.

Defines the AST-validated function in the namespace chosen by builtins_policy. Allowlist mode restricts imports/builtins and private-attribute access; full mode deliberately allows developer code. These Python-level controls are not asserted to provide OS/process isolation.

Imports names enumerated from the installed transformers.modeling_utils namespace to support the separately generated save method; this import statement contains no repository, revision or model-tensor input.

Executes a rewrite of the installed Transformers save method. Hub repository/revision values are repr-serialized after template whitespace normalization; test_zoo_save_revision_literals.py verifies exact literal and uploader value preservation without network access. Other inserted settings derive from the selected dtype and computed shard sizes.

Compiles the installed Gemma4 forward AST after matching exactly one buggy audio cast and adding inputs_embeds.dtype; unexpected source shapes are rejected and original decorators are not re-executed.
Defines that narrowly matched Gemma4 audio-cast rewrite in the installed module namespace, then transplants only its code object after verifying closure compatibility.
Compiles the installed Gemma4 method AST after the fixed PLE linear-call targets and expected source shape match; the AST transformer inserts only the local dtype-cast helper.
Defines the checked PLE dtype rewrite with its local cast helper in the installed module namespace; decorators are removed and code replacement requires equal closure variables.

Resolves the cross-attention module using the internally selected text-model prefix, a range-generated layer index and the fixed cross_attn.qkv_proj suffix.
Resolves a layernorm path assembled from get_model_layer_config's fixed templates and the integer layer index; it is not a path read from arbitrary state-dict keys.
Installs the separately constructed bias object on the template-selected layernorm path; the source contains only the fixed attribute path and local object name.

Both LoRA cast/restore occurrences interpolate the dtype resolved by _get_dtype from the fixed dtype map or imported torch attributes, not the caller's original string; selected modules are existing model objects.
Attaches the separately constructed layernorm weight_param object at a fixed template/index-derived model path; tensor contents never become source.
Attaches a reconstructed parameter using a path from the fixed layer templates and range-generated index; the tensor/Parameter is passed through the local layer object.
Clears a layernorm weight before replacement; the target path is a fixed create_empty_model layer template with an integer index, not a supplied checkpoint key expression.
Attaches a reconstructed linear/quantized layer through a fixed template path with numeric indices; quant_state_dict is queried using that path rather than used to generate arbitrary targets.
Clears a layernorm bias at a target selected from the fixed layer templates before replacing it with the existing bias object.
